colours EXTRACTED from sern_peace_fwcp_2023.qgs (renderer-v2 singleSymbol). Source is a LinePatternFill hatch plus two SimpleLine outlines, which the registry cannot express (gq#24) - the low-opacity fill approximates the hatch weight. NON-legal OGMA is deliberate; the _legal_ variant is a different layer. The shipped .qgs templates carry this layer UNSTYLED (renderer-v2=0), which is why it was never extracted.

symbology AUTHORED, not extracted - no renderer exists in any project checked (shipped templates and sern_peace_fwcp_2023 all carry it with renderer-v2=0). Deliberately reuses provincial_park exact colours so the two read as one family; distinguished by a heavier stroke (1.0 vs 0.66) rather than by a newly invented hue.
